finalModel: Branching cannot self-emerge from DSVC dynamics. Scale-invariance: chain->chain at all scales. Rare surges create larger steps, not forks. Hierarchy adds scale axis, not successors. Determinism precludes multiple successors. Branching requires external modification (stochastic, multi-seed, or explicit DAG).
supportedClaims: Coarse-graining preserves chain topology at all scales
Rare dO surges (0 events detected) do not create forks
Hierarchy depth K has zero effect on branching rate
All DSVC families are scale-invariant (out-degree=1 universal)
